title: Addressing Fear and Risk of Vasovagal Reactions Among High School Donors
brief_summary: In this study, high school donors will be asked about their blood donation-related fears prior to their donation. Half of the donors reporting fear will be assigned to a brief coping skills intervention.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* To be eligible for inclusion in this study, the individual must have presented to donate blood at a New York Blood Center high school blood drive where data is being collected and have passed the health screening process.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Less than 16 years of age; inability to read and comprehend English
